filesystem_integrity.root_opening: open every declared root once as an anchored directory fd with O_RDONLY|O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW; all later access is relative openat-style access from that fd
filesystem_integrity.path_rules: UTF-8 POSIX relative normalized components only; reject empty components, '.', '..', absolute paths, backslashes, NULs, alternate separators, case-fold collisions, and duplicate canonical paths
filesystem_integrity.file_opening: O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW relative to the anchored root fd, then fstat the opened descriptor rather than trusting a pre-open stat
filesystem_integrity.required_file_fstat: regular file, st_nlink == 1, expected size, expected owner policy, and device/inode not seen under another listed path or root
filesystem_integrity.forbidden_entries: symlinks, hardlinks, sockets, FIFOs, devices, mount escapes, sparse aliases, duplicate inodes, and any unlisted file or directory
filesystem_integrity.directory_enumeration: recursive anchored enumeration must equal the exact manifest allowlist plus explicitly named durable markers; reject every missing or extra entry
filesystem_integrity.write_rules: same-directory temporary regular file created O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW, fstat st_nlink==1, complete write, file fsync, atomic os.replace without following links, reopen-and-hash, then parent-directory fsync
filesystem_integrity.secret_exception: the master secret uses its stricter direct O_EXCL 0600 creation contract and never uses a temporary file
filesystem_integrity.checks_repeat: before and after fixture preparation, Phase A, Phase B, and independent verification

persistent_lifecycle_ledger.storage: top-level runtime_pin_mutation_policy.transition_ledger_root; persistent external control root outside every ephemeral job and outside the input/label/Phase-A/Phase-B roots
persistent_lifecycle_ledger.claim_creation: anchored O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW regular-file creation, st_nlink==1, fsync file and directory; claims are append-only and never deleted, replaced, truncated, or reused even after failure
persistent_lifecycle_ledger.PREP: state PREP, predecessor_sha256=null, config_sha256_or_null=SHA-256 of the pre-fixture whole config after every code/test/runner/kernel/environment pin is filled and while fixture hashes remain null; claim exactly once before fixture start marker or first target path construction
persistent_lifecycle_ledger.SEALED: state SEALED, predecessor_sha256=SHA-256 of exact PREP.json bytes, config_sha256_or_null=final fully pinned whole-config SHA-256; claim exactly once after fixture manifests, fixture lock, and final config are independently verified
persistent_lifecycle_ledger.PHASE_A: state PHASE_A, predecessor_sha256=SHA-256 of exact SEALED.json bytes, config_sha256_or_null=same final fully pinned config SHA-256; claim exactly once before submitting or running Phase A
persistent_lifecycle_ledger.LABEL_ACCESS: state LABEL_ACCESS, predecessor_sha256=SHA-256 of exact PHASE_A.json bytes, config_sha256_or_null=same final fully pinned config SHA-256; claim exactly once after immutable Phase-A verification and immediately before TARGET_ACCESS_STARTED and any label identifier/path construction
persistent_lifecycle_ledger.transition_receipts: every report and independent verifier binds all applicable claim byte hashes and confirms strict state order
persistent_lifecycle_ledger.one_run_rule: an existing PREP claim for this protocol_instance_id permanently forbids a second fixture preparation or oracle run; a failed or partial run remains consumed

truth_geometry_assertions.right_inverse: for every non-left-boundary target tile, target_to_slot[p-1] -> target_to_slot[p] is the unique corresponding right truth edge; symmetric assertion for every non-right-boundary tile
truth_geometry_assertions.down_inverse: for every non-top-boundary target tile, target_to_slot[p-24] -> target_to_slot[p] is the unique corresponding down truth edge; symmetric assertion for every non-bottom-boundary tile

truth_geometry_assertions.candidate_truth_intersection: every retained right/down oracle edge must occur in the exact truth sets and preserve inverse/boundary assertions
truth_geometry_assertions.failure: any count, uniqueness, inverse, or boundary mismatch invalidates the entire result

metrics.panel_aggregation: source-macro mean over exactly 32 records, separately after Phase-B label reveal
metrics.balanced_macro: arithmetic mean of the two panel-level means, giving each panel weight 0.5
metrics.origin_recall: for each origin bit, count(true edge keys whose mask contains the bit) / 1104
metrics.oracle_true_component_sizes: sizes returned by grow_components on candidate intersect truth edges, including singleton components
metrics.oracle_non_singleton_covered_tile_fracti: tiles in true-edge components of size>=2 divided by 576
metrics.candidate_restricted_attainable_adjacenc: candidate_union_recall; it is the fraction of all true directed adjacencies explicitly available to a downstream candidate-restricted model
metrics.combined_adjacency: mean of right_adjacency and down_adjacency from layout_metrics
metrics.denoised_render_ssim: the exact RGB SSIM call frozen above
metrics.gate_delta_reference: frozen qap_w4_b0.05_i25 algorithm/hyperparameters for the same opaque fixture record and its fixed opaque nuisance seed; this is not a filename-seed production-layout reproduction claim
required_report_fields: per-record opaque id and hidden panel revealed only in Phase B
baseline and gate-driving layout hashes, validity, adjacency, and SSIM
target-assisted diagnostic metrics clearly marked non-gating

gate.logic: all required integrity and validity checks AND all panel floors AND balanced-macro material-headroom disjunction
gate.exact_boolean_formula: integrity_pass AND for_all(panel in [primary_kornia,independent_libjpeg], recall_mean(panel)>=0.65 AND median_LCC(panel)>=128 AND adjacency_delta_mean(panel)>=0.0 AND ssim_delta_mean(panel)>=0.0) AND (balanced_macro_adjacency_delta>=0.10 OR balanced_macro_ssim_delta>=0.02)
gate.pass_behavior: candidate graph has sufficient ceiling to authorize a separately precommitted cycle-factor graph synchronizer experiment; no solver or submission is promoted
gate.fail_behavior: do not build the cycle-factor synchronizer from this graph; retain qap_w4 and pivot candidate generation or relative-position modeling without reopening QAP weights
gate.mixed_behavior: any missing panel, negative panel delta, integrity failure, or threshold ambiguity is a failure

runtime_pin_mutation_policy.post_fixture_transition: all and only fixture_pin_fields transition together from null to verified lowercase 64-hex after durable fixture lock and before SEALED.json
runtime_pin_mutation_policy.evaluator_hardcode_policy: evaluator hardcodes and verifies only top-level frozen_contract_sha256; it must never hardcode or require the mutable whole-config SHA-256
runtime_pin_mutation_policy.fixture_binding_policy: fixture input/label manifests and fixture lock bind protocol_instance_id, frozen_contract_sha256, and every code_pin_fields SHA-256 value, never whole-config SHA-256
